action_summary: The owner's proposal -- scan an arbitrary environment, diff it against memory, learn what is left -- tested rather than adopted. The three ends existed in the project (environment_probe_v1, ignorance_ledger_v1, jit_knowledge_v1) and nothing joined them. The join is built, and identity in it is CONTENT: what a program that declares a kind actually accepts, not a suffix. Two defects were found by measuring: the scanner's py_compile validator wrote __pycache__ into the directory it measured, and the empty signature ()=(nothing can read these) was learned as a kind so every later unknown file was reported KNOWN. Both fixed and pinned. The claim that signature keying transfers better than suffix keying was measured on 100 real files and WITHDRAWN: both 100/100, signatures buy 0. What signatures buy is lying names, 3 of 7 test files.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: Three routes were rejected. (1) Suffix as identity: the repo already has MAGIC_BY_SUFFIX and it calls a broken JSON known -- 3 of 7 test files are named as a kind their bytes fail. (2) Storing more trajectories: AgentCL measured that continual learning is not solved by storing more, and rounds 6-8 measured that raw actions do not transfer. (3) A second memory store or a second ranking rule: ignorance_ledger_v1 already ranks gaps by value per cost, so a new one would be a part that should not exist.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only: 12 new tests. One receipt: scan 40 real files 5.1s->1.9s, 27 KNOWN 13 UNKNOWN on an unseen directory, lying names 3/3 caught, ranked gaps from the existing ledger. One claim WITHDRAWN after measurement (signatures do not out-transfer suffixes on this repo, 100/100 both). No independent identity has re-run any of it.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: OSWorld 2.0's authors diagnose frontier failure as weak recovery and maintenance of hidden state. A computer-use agent's action is only as good as the invocation it can compose from what the environment declares. Round 7 measured that the composition was wrong for reasons the environment had already published: the same 20 programs yield 33 doors when their declarations are misread and 57 when they are read, with no new knowledge acquired. No benchmark task was run; no discharge is claimed.
